n1.summary: Subtracts a whole-number percentage, rejecting anything outside 0 to 100.

n2.summary: Sums price times quantity, then hands the result to apply_discount.

py.exceptions.here: apply_discount raises ValueError for an out-of-range percent instead of returning a wrong price.

fundamental.text: A bad discount stops the call at raise; total never returns a price computed from it.
